title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC unused variable bytes in write_to
description: In `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` `Fragment::write_to` (line 191), variable `bytes` is assigned but never used: `let bytes = content_len + 1;`. Rust emits `unused variable` warning. Fix: either remove the variable or prefix with underscore.
